sets.ref: hand: the defaults, 1 F from 5 V to 3 V at 10 mA (ESR ignored): t = C x (V1 - V2) / I = 1 x 2 / 0.01 = 200 s; usable energy E = 0.5 x 1 x (25 - 9) = 8 J

hand: Wuerth Elektronik SN009b section 06, 50 F between 2.7 V and 0.3 V at 2 A (the note's example 6.1 is printed for charging, the formula is symmetric): t = 50 x 2.4 / 2 = 60 s; E = 0.5 x 50 x (7.29 - 0.09) = 180 J
hand: Wuerth SN009b example 6.2 (50 F, 2 A for 5 s moves the voltage by dV = I t / C = 0.2 V, from 0.3 V to 0.5 V): t = 50 x (0.5 - 0.3) / 2 = 5 s; E = 0.5 x 50 x (0.25 - 0.09) = 4 J
hand: 10 F from 5 V to 3 V at 0.5 A: t = 10 x 2 / 0.5 = 40 s; E = 0.5 x 10 x 16 = 80 J
hand: the defaults, 1 F from 5 V to 3 V at 50 mW constant power (ESR ignored): t = C x (V1^2 - V2^2) / (2 P) = 1 x 16 / 0.1 = 160 s; E = 8 J = P t
hand: Wuerth SN009b section 07, example 7.1 (50 F, 2.7 V to 0.7 V, 0.2 W, the note prints 850 s): t = 50 x (7.29 - 0.49) / 0.4 = 850 s; E = 170 J
hand: Abracon, Designing with Supercapacitors (408 F, 4.2 V to 3.3 V, 20 W; the note prints about 68 s and about 1360 J): t = 408 x (17.64 - 10.89) / 40 = 68.85 s; E = 1377 J
hand: Wuerth SN009b example 3.1 (0.4 W for 360 s, 2.7 V down to 1 V: E = 144 J, C about 46 F): C = 2 P t / (V1^2 - V2^2) = 288 / 6.29 = 45.787 F; t = 360 s; E = 144 J
hand: Wuerth SN009b example 7.2 (50 F from 2.7 V, 0.7 W for 180 s leaves 1.5 V): t = 50 x (7.29 - 2.25) / 1.4 = 180 s; E = 126 J

solve.ref: hand: constant current: t = 1 x 2 / 0.01 = 200 s, E = 8 J
hand: constant power: t = 1 x 16 / 0.1 = 160 s, E = 8 J
hand: C = I t / (V1 - V2) = 0.002 x 10800 / 2 = 10.8 F (the power value is not used in this mode)
hand: C = 2 P t / (V1^2 - V2^2) = 2 x 0.05 x 10800 / 16 = 67.5 F (the current is not used in this mode)
hand: a cut-off voltage above the start voltage gives a negative time t = 1 x (3 - 5) / 0.01 = -200 s, which is refused (range), and the check fires
hand: in the power mode t = 1 x (9 - 25) / 0.1 = -160 s is refused (range) and the check fires
